items.t: Said that neighbors coming out to help a person during an ICE incident is an example of Minnesotans helping their neighbors.
items.q: If there were neighbors and others who came out to help this person, that is just an example of Minnesota being a place where we help our neighbors,

items.t: Said that ICE agents have been coming to Minnesota, numbering over two thousand, and have been attacking and terrorizing the state.
items.q: And we are clear that the ICE agents have been coming here — and there’s over two thousand of them — and they’ve been attacking and terrorizing our state.

items.t: Said that any pursuit or apprehension of a person can be done in a respectful and fair way.
items.q: And when we think in terms of any pursuit or any apprehension of anyone, there’s a way for you to do your work where it’s respectful and it’s fair.

items.t: Called on the BCA to investigate a police-involved shooting and on the Minneapolis Police Department to review and modify existing policies.
items.q: I call upon the BCA to investigate the matter and for MPD to review and modify existing policies that will protect all of us.

items.t: Said that a setback can be an opportunity for a comeback and asked how to identify solutions that bring young people back into law-abiding behavior.
items.q: A setback can also be an opportunity for a comeback. How do we identify solutions that bring them back into law-abiding behavior?

record.t: Served in the Minnesota House from 2009 to 2012 and in the Minnesota Senate from 2013 to the present.
Served as chair of a Senate panel, according to Fox News.
record.q: Democratic Sen. Bobby Joe Champion of Minneapolis, who chairs the panel, told his colleagues that the prudent thing to do was to wait until the evidence could be tested for accuracy.
